remarks: This stunning 3 bedroom, 2 bath Colonial is packed with character, featuring gleaming inlaid hardwood floors, gorgeous natural woodwork, coffered ceilings and beautiful leaded glass. The updated kitchen shines with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances. Enjoy modern comforts including new windows, central air, hot water heat and radiant floor heating. A first-floor full bath and laundry add convenience. The massive primary bedroom boasts two large closets, while the beautifully updated full bath features a heated floor. The partially finished third floor offers exciting possibilities for an additional bedroom, playroom or bonus space. Outside, relax on the cozy front porch or enjoy the fun rear porch overlooking the deep backyard. A stamped concrete patio is perfect for entertaining! Additional highlights include a well-maintained slate roof, updated mechanicals, dry basement and two-car garage. Timeless architecture, incredible woodwork and thoughtful updates make this Elmwood Village gem one you won't want to miss!
